deep_research.description: Starts a bounded multi-agent investigation that can analyze the supplied context and attachments and use web search when useful.
rules: DEEP_RESEARCH includes web search when external evidence is useful, but it is not limited to web search.
Use it for a substantial investigation or analysis that benefits from independent research agents, including analysis of supplied images or other context.
Do not use it for a simple lookup or a question that Brain can answer directly.
